Location: The Netherlands | Full-time | Open to candidates currently based in Spain Are you experienced in Revit or BIM and interested in moving your career into the high-voltage and energy infrastructure sector? As an Electrical BIM Modeler, you will work on the design and development of high-voltage substations in the Netherlands. You will work on both new substations and extensions or modifications of existing installations. What will you do? You will be responsible for developing and maintaining BIM models for electrical substation projects. Your work will include: Creating and updating 3D BIM models for high-voltage substations; Modelling electrical equipment and substation components in Autodesk Revit; Working with equipment such as transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, busbars, cable routes and supporting structures; Producing layouts, sections, details and technical drawings from the 3D model; Adding and maintaining technical information and object data within the BIM environment; Coordinating the electrical model with Civil, Structural and other engineering disciplines; Identifying clashes and design inconsistencies; Processing design changes throughout different project phases; Supporting Primary and Secondary Engineers with model-based engineering; Contributing to BIM standards, libraries and modelling workflows; Checking models and drawings for quality, completeness and constructability. BIM Modeler, BIM Coordinator or Electrical Engineering; Bicycle leasing and fitness schemes; International and multidisciplinary engineering projects; A professional but informal working environment. Why move from Spain to the Netherlands? The Netherlands is investing heavily in the expansion and reinforcement of its electricity grid. This creates long-term engineering opportunities in substations and high-voltage infrastructure. For an experienced electrical BIM professional, this role offers the opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in a sector with a substantial long-term project pipeline. Depending on your experience, you may also take responsibility for technical coordination or act as Design Lead for specific engineering packages. Cinekid is looking for film fanatics between 16 and 20 years old from (the) Amsterdam (area) to introduce films and supervise Q&As during Cinekid Festival 2026. Youth presenters wanted! 
Are you a cinema lover, have you seen everything on Netflix or do you have the sharpest analyses on your friends' TikToks? Do you enjoy being in front of an audience to act or present, for example? Then become a youth presenter during Cinekid Festival 2026! 
Cinekid is thé media- and film festival of the Netherlands. Here you can attend the coolest workshops and watch the best children's films. It doesn't stop there: after a selection of film screenings, a Q&A takes place. This is an after-screening where a guest is invited for an interview. Among others directors and film stars who are only too happy to tell you the most interesting and funniest facts about their film. 
 What does a youth presenter do? 
As a presenter, you are responsible for introducing the films and leading the Q&As afterwards. In the introduction, you welcome the audience in the room and introduce the film they will be watching. During the Q&As, you will talk to the filmmakers and/or actors of the film and ask them questions! You will also coordinate questions from the audience. You can work as a presenter on your own, but we usually assign you in pairs. You can also invite a friend! 
 Who are you? 
 - You speak Dutch - You enjoy being in front of a (large) audience - You live in (the vicinity of) Amsterdam - As presenter, you are available for at least 3 days between 10 October and 16 October 2026 - Prior to the festival, you will get a training.
